content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: a visible validation error appears on the sales invoice:new form after Save is clicked, and the same error also appears when Payment Due Date receives input before any Save click, so the Payment Due Date field is the likely trigger; users then edit Customer and Payment Due Date and click Save again (S0d948c20: events 600, 601:e617, 662, 664:e689 with edits at 668 and 666; S1ff222ed: events 611, 612:e657, 673, 675:e726 with edits at 618 and 680).", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, when Save is clicked with an invalid form, scroll to and focus the first invalid input and render its message directly beneath that input (for example under Payment Due Date), instead of a generic error that does not identify the field; also check the Payment Due Date validation rule so it does not flag the value on first input.", "cited_event_ids": ["344", "353:a352", "353", "362:a369", "600", "601:e617", "662", "664:e689", "668", "666", "611", "612:e657", "673", "675:e726", "618", "680"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text of the visible error messages is not in the events, so the failing field and rule cannot be confirmed.", "Whether the error comes from client-side or server-side validation is not shown.", "Whether Customer, rather than Payment Due Date, is also causing the error is not confirmed; Customer edits occur between attempts but no error is tied to Customer.", "The Save element's position (x=1400, y=25) and the separate Submit dialog flow are not analysed as causes."]}
